note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) campground on a heavily wooded peninsula in Crescent Lake, about 24 miles north-northeast of Tofte via the Sawbill Trail and Forest Road 170 (The Grade). Many sites have filtered views of the lake through pine, spruce and birch; the sites nearest the shore are the tent sites on the north point. Recreation.gov lists RVs and trailers only on the reservable back-in sites along the peninsula road; the first-come sites are listed for cars and tents. Boat ramp and accessible fishing pier. The boat-in backcountry site south of the campground is separate. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 233146 read: 32 sites (20 reservable incl. group, 13 FCFS), $20 ($40 group), 2027 same, nonelectric, vault toilets + solar faucet, 4-day cutoff, all FCFS Oct 1-20, 14-night limit, 9 people, second vehicle $10. Season May 8-Oct 19 (manual) matches the FS page. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (canopy, RV pads 60-120 m back). Pin at the north end, 550 m from the RV sites. Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (defaults down; reviewer to confirm). The FS and rec.gov text says 'providing many sites with nice views of the water and some sites with access to the water' and 'The entire campground is heavily wooded'. On Esri imagery the 12 reservable RV/trailer sites (009, 012, 013, 016, 017, 020, 021, 023, 025, 026, 030, 031; e.g. 016 at 47.82974,-90.77424, 020 at 47.82860,-90.77399) sit on the west side of the peninsula road 60-120 m from the east shore through continuous forest. The sites nearest the water are tent-only 001/003/005 on the north point (47.8324,-90.7711 to 47.8314,-90.7710) and parallel site 006 (47.83323,-90.77068, catalog equipment Tent only), about 30-40 m from the shore under trees. rec.gov tags six FIRST-COME sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (002, 004, 007, 014, 018, 029), all listed for Car/Tent only and with no coordinates; the clearings east of the road (e.g. near 47.8304,-90.7727 and 47.8285,-90.7725) look like them but sit 40-60 m from the water under canopy. No RV pad on open ground within ~50 m, so not lakefront; the official 'many sites with nice views' supports lakeview.

FIT: rec.gov lists RV and Trailer (Max Vehicle Length 45, Driveway Length 40, back-in) on the 12 reservable sites named above, RV to 25 ft on 010 and 027; the 13 first-come sites list only Car and Tent (10 ft), which may be a placeholder for unplaced FCFS sites. FS page: 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderately sized vehicle, some may not be suitable for an RV' (Superior NF boilerplate, also on Cascade River). A 23-ft rig fits the 12 reservable back-ins. sites.max_rig_ft not written (the catalog's 45 exceeds its own 40-ft driveways).

PIN 47.8332,-90.7710 is at parallel site 006 in the north (tent) cluster; the RV sites run 0.3-0.7 km south along the peninsula road. Suggest 47.8286,-90.7740 (by sites 020/021, the middle of the RV sites), about 550 m from the stored pin. The FS point 47.82520,-90.77299 is at the south end (site 031); rec.gov's 47.83676,-90.77314 is on the entrance road.

PHONE missing: rec.gov facility phone 218-663-7150 with info@sawbill.com (Sawbill Canoe Outfitters, the concessionaire named on rec.gov); FS page gives the Tofte Ranger District, 218-663-8060. Suggest 218-663-7150 (or 218-663-8060 if the district line is preferred). Ownership federal stays (concession on NFS land).
